title: Appraisal Desk Note: Reappraisal Allowance on a Further Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Age of the appraisal.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the age of the case's as-is appraisal is the number of whole calendar months from the appraisal date to the grant date. An appraisal dated after the grant date counts as less than 4 months old.

**Rule.**

- Where the case has no appraisal recorded, 30 calendar days are added to the extension length for ordering one.
- Where the appraisal is at least the plan's appraisal validity in months old (6 months under every plan), 21 calendar days are added to it for the reappraisal.
- Where it is at least 4 and less than 6 months old, 7 calendar days are added to it.
- Where it is less than 4 months old, nothing is added.

| Appraisal at the grant date | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|
| none recorded | 30 |
| 6 whole months or more | 21 |
| 4 or 5 whole months | 7 |
| under 4 whole months, or dated after the grant | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; grant on 28 February)

| Appraisal date | Whole months | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 29 October | 3 | 0 |
| 28 October | 4 | 7 |
| 28 August | 6 | 21 |
